findings.title: The consent read keys on a classification whose AI-mediated and Granted definitions leave the body
findings.recommendation:
D2's A1 now reads "On an arrival classified above as AI-mediated or granted, read references/consent-at-entry.md".
But the same bullet moves the AI-mediated and Granted bullets whole, and those bullets are where the two classes are
defined: AI-mediated is "everything else — delegation phrases ("finish the cadence"), inference ("continue"), a handoff
document, a chain, or an eligibility readout pointing here" (archive-change.ts:459, apply's Step 0 alike), and Granted is
the chain object reporting this command with may_run: true (archive-change.ts:460). After the move, the body defines
only User-invoked and the uncertainty rule. A clear "continue" arrival is not uncertain, so nothing left in the body
classifies it as AI-mediated, and "classified above" points at text that is in the reference the sentence is deciding
whether to read.
The lifecycle-consent delta's new bullet (specs/orbit-lifecycle-consent/spec.md:39-41) already says the body keeps "the
provenance classification". D2 disagrees with it.
Make D2 match the delta: the body keeps each class's classifying clause (AI-mediated: everything not user-invoked, with
its examples; Granted: the chain object's next is this command with may_run: true, read at entry). Only the procedures
move: the prompt, the preview and outward line, what each path records, and the tag handling. Name the kept clauses in
D2's A1 and in task 4.1, re-measure A1's span for both bodies (archive's margin after R2 is about 340), and have task
4.1's test assert that both class definitions stay in each body.

walk_entry.title: Positional pointers in the moved text go wrong beyond the one D1 rewords

commentary:
This pass verified the two walk logs of the blind pair. I re-read each resolution's sweep scope against current
sources: the propose, archive and apply templates, pr-choreography.ts' archive-tail reference, the cut-ledger,
chain-prompt-tags, pr-references and size-declaration-parity tests, the scenario ledger and skill_body_convention.md.
Every quoted line and string was found where the walks said. Archive's re-measured table adds up: the A4 pieces sum to
557, and the moves come to about 5,170, about 170 over. The residual diff since the base pass touches only files in the
walks' edit records.
One gap matters. Moving the AI-mediated and Granted bullets whole also moves the definitions that the new read
sentence relies on. The lifecycle-consent delta already says the classification stays in the body, so the repair is
in design and tasks, and the spec is unchanged. The other finding is a garbled task sentence the walk left behind.
The three converged stale calls in the external log are correct: each names the fresh walk log, and the fix it points
to is present.
